name: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd
title: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd - 539046 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Manaksia added 36% alu-zinc capacity (132k→180k t) and is ramping, with Q4 EBITDA margin squeezed to 6.84% by energy and raw-material shock; management says new orders pass through full cost increases.

utilisation.quote: And as on date, we are already using upwards of 60%, 65% capacity utilization on the new alu-zinc line

capex.quote: we have placed an order with Mas Rollpro Limited for our second color coating line

triggers.label: Alu-zinc utilisation 60-65% now
triggers.quote: we are already using upwards of 60%, 65% capacity utilization on the new alu-zinc line

triggers.label: Alu-zinc premium INR3,000-5,000/t
triggers.quote: a premium of between INR3,000 to INR5,000 a ton is a ballpark that one can say is a fair premium over galvanized steel

triggers.label: Second colour line 150k t adds capacity
triggers.quote: This line will add 150,000 metric tons of color coating capacity, taking our total capacity from 86,000 tons to 2,36,000 tons

guidance.metric: FY27 incremental revenue from new capacity
guidance.quote: we can anticipate anywhere between -- let's say, anywhere between INR300 crores to INR500 crores
an EBITDA margin of anywhere between 10% to 12% is possible and sustainable
we'll strive to actually be anywhere in the range of between 1x to 1.5x
it has the potential to basically generate savings of between INR7 crores to INR7.5 crores per annum

red_flags.label: Q4 margin compression and volume ramp
red_flags.quote: EBITDA for Q4 FY '26 stood at INR15.64 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6.84%.

red_flags.label: Management assumes cost pass-through without evidence
red_flags.quote: we are successfully able to pass through the entire impact of the incremental costs to our customers

evasions.quote: for me to tell you what will be the ROCE of the project is very difficult at this point of time
it will be wrong for me to give a round figure or a number to you
I think you can do the math and potentially come to a conclusion on that. Yes?
